test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 12 Dec 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Three different positions of the same dice are shown. Find the number on the face opposite the face showing '2'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e0e56ad560a56af2d00052a94775a4be19d0487475764b6633e680dc985d0bda.png]
solution:
The pattern followed here is:

Logic: No two opposite faces are adjacent to each other.

Let's find which number is faced opposite to face having '2'.

We are taking both dice figures (1) & (2) together.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0ff6b494f80175ee19601d75a751b9ae6f707a92f87391151dc49ef9fe362dcb.png] 

Here, 6 and 3 are common in both dice and 5 is opposite to 2.

Now, we are taking dice figures (2) & (3) together.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6f400aee6f71d4ce2e60bbfd4107a1ac1d06b56cba615c5d1ecc1d434ad3318f.png] 

Here, 2 is common in both the dice and the rotated clockwise direction.

Opposite pairs:

⇒ 5 ⇔ 2

⇒ 6 ⇔ 1

⇒ 3 ⇔ 4

Clearly, 5 is the opposite of 2.

Hence, the correct answer is "5".
